Package fileHandleUtils

Class PodcastFileProcessor

java.lang.Object
fileHandleUtils.PodcastFileProcessor
All Implemented Interfaces:
BaseFileProcessor
public class PodcastFileProcessor extends Object implements BaseFileProcessor
The PodcastFileProcessor class is responsible for processing and validating podcast media files. It implements the BaseFileProcessor interface to provide functionality for reading, validating, and creating Podcast objects from file data.
